source.manualTitle: Whirlpool & Maytag 6.2 cu ft Direct Drive Top Load Washer

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: WARNING — Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before servicing.

steps.title: Access UI service LEDs
steps.body: Separate glass top from lid frame (Whirlpool) or access console UI (Maytag). Locate amber Power, blue Data, white Button Sounds LEDs.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Separate glass top from lid frame (Whirlpool) or access console UI (Maytag). Locate amber Power, blue Data, white Button Sounds LEDs.

steps.title: Service Power LED flashes at 1 Hz
steps.body: With power applied, does amber Service Power LED flash?
steps.sourceExcerpt: With power applied, does amber Service Power LED flash?

branches.label: No flash
branches.oemOutcome: UI not powered — check harness and ACU (TEST #1, #4).

steps.title: Service Data LED illuminates
steps.body: Press POWER or cycle power. Does blue Service Data LED illuminate?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press POWER or cycle power. Does blue Service Data LED illuminate?

steps.title: Button Sounds LED with audio enabled
steps.body: Control Lock off. Audio Level not muted. Does white Service Button Sounds LED illuminate?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Control Lock off. Audio Level not muted. Does white Service Button Sounds LED illuminate?

steps.title: Check UI harness and ACU
steps.oemOutcome: Verify J18/UI harness continuity per TEST #4.

steps.title: Replace UI
steps.oemOutcome: All three service LEDs do not behave — replace user interface.

steps.title: Service LEDs verified
steps.oemOutcome: Service Power, Data, and Button Sounds LEDs behave per manual.
